correctness.rationale: A universal lexicographic exchange proves greedy cardinality optimality for any prefix when durations are equal; a chronological-cyclic feasibility invariant proves simultaneous conflict-freeness and EFX. For every epsilon, four explicit rational intervals realize exact 4-to-3 obstruction, while all feasible sets of size at most three are recolorable equitably on two machines. Standalone independent enumerations on 19,305 plus 455 grid instances and four rational perturbations corroborate all proof components.

value.rationale: Equal-duration unweighted service requests form a natural controlled scheduling model; the result determines both a zero-loss online fair algorithm and a discontinuous worst-case fairness loss as soon as any positive duration heterogeneity is permitted. The four-job minimality distinguishes a structural boundary from an arbitrary parameter slice and identifies a hard obstruction for fair schedulers.
